claims.title: Sol ratio-free positive-unpaired bounded-head cleanup and delayed repayment

quoted_fields.interface: For each fixed bounded anchor head H and positive raw rates,there exist eps,n0 such that n=min(B-C,E-F)>=n0 and C+F<=eps*n admit an actual stop with E[sigma+Jnc+Zout^2]<=Zin^2,with NO upper ratio bound on the two positive unpaired inventories. Z=15+M-m(A)-m(D),m=(0,2,4,7,7,...).
quoted_fields.failure: Negative/mixed signs,other minority regimes,unbounded initial anchors and global receiving/full recurrence remain open. Constants can be extremely poor;no practical solver claim.
